overview_description.description: Ornadyne develops flapping-wing unmanned aerial vehicles that resemble real birds for covert reconnaissance and surveillance. The company focuses on near-silent, man-portable drones that look, fly, and sound like birds to reduce visual and acoustic detectability. Its systems integrate onboard cameras and autonomy software to support military reconnaissance missions in contested environments. Ornadyne designs its aircraft for efficiency, endurance, and reliable field operation. The platform targets defense and security customers that require close-range surveillance where traditional quadcopters and fixed-wing drones are easily detected.
